description: Get the build output logs for a Code Engine build run (via the CE Kubernetes API proxy). Surfaces the container build steps so you can see why a build failed. Build pods are retained only briefly after completion.

namespace.description: Optional: project namespace (subdomain) override, if it cannot be auto-derived.

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return per container (default: 200)

name: ce_get_build_run_logs
